'''Balluzikik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and the mate of [[Slizzik]]. He was part of the bounty hunter crew formed by the [[Taloron Hunters|Taloron Hunter]] [[Crutag]] that chased a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trinta]]. While on the planet, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Halagad Ventor]] used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to scare Balluzikik to [[Death/Legends|death]].
